## Roles and handoff
- Developer role / branch:
- Reviewed head SHA:
- QA reviewer role, exact SHA and verdict (PR comment link):
- Product decision (issue/PR comment link):
- Release engineer merge/rework decision (PR comment link):

## Player-visible outcome
What changed, why it meets the Issue's acceptance criteria, and what remains out of scope.

## Verification
- [ ] Relevant tests and lint/typecheck/build completed (paste commands/results)
- [ ] CI checks completed (link actual run)
- [ ] Changed UX inspected on real viewport (if applicable; link screenshots)
- [ ] Save/persistence/rollback effects examined
- [ ] Sensitive files, runtime state and unrelated changes excluded
- [ ] Independent QA head-SHA comment is current
- [ ] Product acceptance is linked
- [ ] Release engineer inspected this diff and checks

**Policy:** only release engineer merges; a PR may be returned to its developer for rework. All personas share one GitHub login; role-stamped comments are evidence, not formal independent GitHub account approvals.
